programme.title: The Assistant
programme.desc: A man deals with working as a helper for an insufferable social-media celebrity.

programme.title: The Loved Ones
programme.desc: A high-school wallflower and her demented father kidnap a classmate after he rejects her invitation to a dance, and the pair take him to a secluded cabin for a night of extreme punishment.

programme.title: Rumours
programme.desc: At an exclusive political summit, seven world leaders get hopelessly lost in misty woods while drafting a crisis statement. As night falls, their predicament turns from comedic to horrific, with surreal encounters testing their already questionable leadership abilities and exposing the absurdity of power.

programme.title: Mommie Dearest
programme.desc: Based on Christina Crawford's memoirs about her Hollywood upbringing and her mother Joan Crawford's hang-ups, the film depicts the abuse and trauma suffered by Christina.

programme.title: April Fool's Day
programme.desc: College students are invited to the remote island estate of their rich schoolmate, Muffy, for a weekend of fun. Muffy sets up practical jokes for her visitors, and it's all fun and games until the co-eds start disappearing one by one.

programme.title: The Devil Inside
programme.desc: A woman discovers that her mother was undergoing an exorcism when she committed three murders, and she travels to Italy with a documentary crew to uncover the full truth of what happened.

programme.title: Area 51
programme.desc: Found-footage shocker about a group of amateur researchers who uncover horrific secrets when they infiltrate Area 51, the government facility alleged to contain aliens.

programme.title: Judgment Night
programme.desc: A detour leads four friends into a nightmarish bout with drug-dealing gangsters. Emilio Estevez, Cuba Gooding Jr. Fallon: Denis Leary. Wyatt: Stephen Dorff. Cochran: Jeremy Piven. Sykes: Peter Greene. Rhodes: Erik Schrody. Travis: Michael Wiseman. Directed by Stephen Hopkins.

programme.title: The Gunman
programme.desc: A government agent goes on the run from his own agency, in an effort to try and clear his name.

programme.title: Ida Red
programme.desc: After being given 20 years in prison for armed robbery, career criminal Ida "Red" Walker fears that she won't survive long enough to see through her sentence due to being diagnosed with a terminal illness. Intent on staging one last heist, she turns to her son and right hand Wyatt to help her bring her plans to completion, and to give her a chance to regain her freedom.

programme.title: Snake Eyes
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage stars in this highly stylized 1998 thriller directed by Brain De Palma. Cage plays a crooked cop investigating the assassination of the Secretary of Defense, who was shot at a championship boxing match in Atlantic City. As the investigation proceeds, he is forced to realizes that one of his closest friends (Gary Sinise), a Navy commander, may have been involved.

programme.title: Judgment Night
programme.desc: A detour leads four friends into a nightmarish bout with drug-dealing gangsters. Emilio Estevez, Cuba Gooding Jr. Fallon: Denis Leary. Wyatt: Stephen Dorff. Cochran: Jeremy Piven. Sykes: Peter Greene. Rhodes: Erik Schrody. Travis: Michael Wiseman. Directed by Stephen Hopkins.

programme.title: New Jack City
programme.desc: Streetwise cops target a megalomaniacal drug lord, whose empire is threatened by an informer.

programme.title: The Last Manhunt
programme.desc: In 1909, Willie Boy and his love Carlota go on the run after he accidentally shoots her father in a confrontation gone terribly wrong. With President Taft coming to the area, the local sheriff leads two Native American trackers seeking justice for their "murdered" tribal leader.

programme.title: Ain't Them Bodies Saints
programme.desc: In 1970s Texas, a notorious outlaw claims responsibility for his wife's murder of a police officer. Years later, he attempts to break out of prison to reunite with his beloved and their daughter.

programme.title: Snake Eyes
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage stars in this highly stylized 1998 thriller directed by Brain De Palma. Cage plays a crooked cop investigating the assassination of the Secretary of Defense, who was shot at a championship boxing match in Atlantic City. As the investigation proceeds, he is forced to realizes that one of his closest friends (Gary Sinise), a Navy commander, may have been involved.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: Retired CIA hit man Frank Moses and his former colleagues race to find out why they've been targeted for death by their former organisation and uncover a vast conspiracy implicating some prominent politicians in the process.

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After young teenager Susie Salmon is murdered, she watches over her grieving parents, as well as her unapprehended killer, from a heaven of her own creation. Susie must come to terms with her own death, while sharing the pain her father and mother are working through.

programme.title: Love and Other Impossible Pursuits
programme.desc: Jack leaves his wife for Emilia, only to find his new marriage marked by tragedy. His son William seems intent on making Emilia's life miserable, and their union takes a sharp turn for the worse when their newborn baby dies suddenly.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: In this richly nuanced coming-of-age drama, a high-school basketball star named Anthony seems to have a promising future ahead of him, but it's threatened by his father's severe gambling addiction. As Anthony pursues an athletic scholarship at Cornell, his dad gets tangled up with the mob.

programme.title: 45 Years
programme.desc: An ageing couple's marriage is challenged when the body of the husband's ex-fiancée is discovered, more than 50 years after she disappeared during a holiday in Switzerland.

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
